title: Add Pannable Semio Diagram
description: Add panning to the semio/ui Diagram viewport while preserving the existing zoom, diff colors, selection, and click callbacks. Implement local pointer drag panning suitable for the mini-map/preview component and verify semio/ui type-check and Storybook build.
summary: Added pointer drag panning to the semio/ui Diagram viewport on the empty canvas while preserving zoom, diff colors, selection, and piece/connection click callbacks. Re-verified semio/ui type-check and Storybook build.
